purpose: Extend the immutable 0.2 evidence-state contract with exact Renshaw and NPY-positive source-local routes while preserving preparation conflicts, PCA-morphometry boundaries, native-DAT non-admission, exact-physiology non-joins, and zero-primitive internal-detail absence.

representationStates.label: Observed raw texture
representationStates.meaning: Checksum-verified source pixels or voxels in their declared source frame.
representationStates.visualRule: source texture only; no generated cell boundary
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: segmentation, cell identity or 3D surface unless separately admitted

representationStates.label: Observed segmented surface
representationStates.meaning: Exact source segmentation boundary represented by checksum-verified vertices and triangles.
representationStates.visualRule: source surface with object ID and frame receipt
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: molecular membrane composition or measurement surface

representationStates.label: Observed skeleton
representationStates.meaning: Source-local standardized SWC coordinates, topology and source types.
representationStates.visualRule: centerlines; constant stroke width is a viewer aid
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: membrane, complete arbor, atlas position or internal structure

representationStates.label: Observed source point
representationStates.meaning: One exact source coordinate row rendered without biological radius.
representationStates.visualRule: radius-free point glyph in its source representation
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: soma geometry, neurites, cross-frame identity or atlas registration

representationStates.label: Radius-derived display surface
representationStates.meaning: Deterministic open frusta derived from source-authorized SWC endpoint radii.
representationStates.visualRule: open six-sided per-edge frusta plus visible observed centerlines
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: observed membrane, watertight biological surface or measurement

representationStates.label: Inferred reference geometry
representationStates.meaning: Reference-only loft or plane-local display geometry derived from pinned atlas annotations.
representationStates.visualRule: muted reference envelope or exact sampled-plane edges
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: registration of any cell, interpolation of missing labels or measurement

representationStates.label: Schematic evidence path
representationStates.meaning: A non-anatomical path used only to organize an evidence entity.
representationStates.visualRule: dashed path in the synthetic evidence lane
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: observed axon, projection, connection or anatomical trajectory

representationStates.label: Synthetic data glyph
representationStates.meaning: A non-cell UI object representing a literature evidence entity or injury-state record.
representationStates.visualRule: faceted data glyph or wire frame, explicitly outside anatomy
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: soma, cell cluster geometry, membrane, count, spatial density or morphology

representationStates.label: Unavailable object geometry
representationStates.meaning: No object-level source geometry has been admitted for the requested layer.
representationStates.visualRule: zero primitives plus explicit missingness text
representationStates.forbiddenClaim: procedural spheres, capsules, tubes, boxes or any other geometric substitute

globalInvariants: Every rendered scientific object exposes a stable ID, representation state, source frame, source version and checksum receipt in machine-readable runtime metadata.
A SYN data glyph is never a soma, cell cluster, spatial density estimate or observed morphology.
A DER radius surface is never an observed membrane and is unavailable when the source does not authorize diameter.
An OBS segmented surface is a source segmentation boundary, not a molecular membrane measurement.
Unsupported or unadmitted object geometry always produces zero primitives; procedural biological proxies are prohibited.
Co-display, selection and camera switching create no cross-source identity, coordinate join or atlas registration.

Each dorsal-horn route-pack route remains an independent source-local reconstruction; admission creates no average cell, selected-SCI-entity identity, cross-source molecular identity or atlas registration.
Standardized soma points produced by contour averaging are display proxies, never native contour vertices, membranes or volumetric soma segmentations.
Bundled source-native DAT bytes are provenance receipts only: without a validated parser and object dictionary they contribute zero admitted semantic objects and zero rendered primitives.
Paper-level electrophysiology cannot be assigned to a deposited morphology unless the article or an official source exposes an exact object key; neither added route passes that join gate.
Repository 95-percent PCA morphometry is distinct from raw standardized-SWC bounds, anatomical axes, and atlas registration.
Repository-versus-paper preparation, strain, and weight conflicts remain explicit and cannot be silently normalized for display.
